## Rock 3 (#4): shallow-clone tolerance
`match_git_evidence` gains a keyword argument `shallow: bool = False` (the caller supplies `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository`)
and a `commit_present: Mapping[str, bool]` argument, built by the caller with `git cat-file -e <sha>^{commit}` per recorded SHA (never from the 50-commit list, whose absence proves nothing). The existing result record gains a `commit_status` value `"unverifiable_shallow"` only when `commit_present[sha]` is false AND `shallow` is true; absent and non-shallow stays an error as today,
instead of silently dropping them or raising. Non-shallow results stay identical (assert with a pre/post golden test).
Proof: same pytest file.
